mission.title: Highly Polished
mission.description: Follow the encrypted data back to Silver, break into his network with Polyxena, and find out what he has done with the key.

npc.say: Think it over, meatbag. Who am I kidding... let your boss think it over. You're not qualified.

phase.briefing:
We've been looking at that porn collection of yours, {player}. You really are the kinky one, aren't you?
Anyhow, my people cracked the encryption, and determined the source: Silver. He has a hand in this somehow, and you're going to find out exactly what that is.
Pick up Polyxena. She'll help you with the rest of this mission.

talk.say: So you're {player}. Flood already briefed me, so let's get going.
Just show me one thing: where they are.

objective.text: Lead Polyxena out of the area

phase.briefing:
All right, I see you and Polyxena are getting along splendidly. That puts my heart at ease, it really does.
Now stop wasting time and get over to one of Silver's outposts. You've got some data collection to take care of.

enter.say: Okay, this is a major processing center of Silver's.

objective.text: Lead Polyxena to the main terminal

done.say: Bingo! Now get Polyxena in here.
Looks like Polyxena just downloaded the data you need onto a disk. Grab it from the computer and you can get out of there.

objective.text: Get the Disk from the computer

done.say: Great. You can let Polyxena find her own way out; now on to the next location.

phase.briefing:
Now that you have that disk, you should be able to get into Silver's communications network. I'm sending you to another lab.
Don't mess this up, {player}.

enter.say: Get in there, find an active computer, pop that disk in, and do a quick scan of the info. Don't get tied down if you can avoid it.

objective.text: Put the Disk in the computer

done.say: He's getting the key "out"? Wonder what that means.

phase.briefing:
So Silver wants in on this party too, eh? It's getting a little more crowded than I like.
Time to bring it to him, {player}. Go into Silver's place, wreck it if you want, and certainly take him out. Just get that key before he can move it somewhere else.

enter.say: Don't be shy about knocking some heads in here, {player}! We have to show Silver who's boss.

talk.say:
Oh, look, the meatbag's here. I heard about you going through my stuff. Not very nice. And now you bust up my place... and all for no point.
That's right, the key's gone, and you can't get to it. Too bad, so sad.
I suppose you want to kill me now? Well stop a minute, meatbag, and consider this: How are you going to get the key if you do that? It's sitting, perfectly safe, in a tidy little construct right now, completely beyond your reach. The Merovingian can't even access it there. But maybe we can make a deal.
Zion has the case, right? You get it, bring it to me, we unlock it and split what's inside. Can't beat that logic, meatbag.

done.say: He thinks we'll make a deal? He's... bah, get out of there. I need to think.

mission.finish: Get back to me, {player}. This is getting complicated.
